note: Wahpeton Parks & Recreation area at the north end of town off 4th Street North, on the river, with two picnic shelters, a boat landing, fishing pier and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Wahpeton Parks page read: 8 paved RV sites (30A, 50A on 1 and 8, water), $35 online-only prepaid, monthly $900, tents $20; showers, dump; season ~04-15 to mid-October (closed 10/13/2025). Riverview stands (pads not identifiable on imagery; no named site over open ground at the bank). River is the Red, not the Bois de Sioux. LEAD: Chahinkapa Park Campground (Wahpeton), not in the DB.
flags: RIVER NAME: the stored note says 'on the Bois de Sioux River'. Kidder sits ~2.5 km north (downstream) of where the Bois de Sioux and Otter Tail meet at Wahpeton-Breckenridge, so the river here is the Red River. The Wahpeton page names no river. The new note just says 'on the river'.

WATERFRONT: riverview stands. The river here is ~35-40 m wide (zoom-19 tile at 46.2879,-96.5979). The camping area is the scattered-tree lawn between the park road and the bank, with a paved walking path and a brush/rip-rap fringe along the shore. The eight pads cannot be told apart on imagery, and no site map was found, so there are no named sites to support an upgrade.

PIN: stored 46.28794,-96.59833 is on the riverside path at the west end of the camping lawn, by the restroom building. The pads are not identifiable on imagery. The camping lawn runs NE from there to the boat-landing lot at about 46.2889,-96.5965, so the pin is within ~150 m of any of them. Keep.

LEAD: Chahinkapa Park Campground, Wahpeton (in Chahinkapa Park by the zoo, about 46.265,-96.606). The same Wahpeton page lists it: 'RV sites with electrical hookups, showers and restrooms and sewer disposal. Spots 1 and 7 are $40 per night for electricity and water hook-ups. Spots 2-6 have electricity for $35 per night. Call Chahinkapa Zoo at 701-642-8709'. No entry in campgrounds.json; not vetted.
LONG STAY: a monthly rate ($900) is posted, but extended stays are case by case and the eight sites are sold nightly online. No drop concern.
FIT: 'paved camper/RV spots'; no length posted. Imagery shows short paved back-in spurs off the park road, long enough for an ordinary trailer rig. Keep.
PHONE/WEBSITE: (701) 642-2811 is the parks office on the page header; website already the campground page. No change.
